lines.en: label yukigennight:
I tap on Yuki's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Yuki 的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: : Yo.
: Hey. Are you free tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿。今晚有空吗？

lines.en: : Free every night. This mean what I think it means?
lines.zh: : 我每晚都有空。这意思是我想的那个意思吗？

lines.en: : Does what you think it means involve a sketchy ramen joint?
lines.zh: : 你想的那个意思里，包含一家可疑的拉面店吗？

lines.en: : Always does.
lines.zh: : 一向如此。

lines.en: : You there now?
lines.zh: : 你现在在那儿？

lines.en: : No, but I'll start heading over now if you want to meet up.
lines.zh: : 不在，但你要见的话，我现在就动身。

lines.en: : Sounds good.
: Want me to order for you since you're a bike-fearing pansy without a license of your own?
lines.zh: : 要不要我先帮你点？反正你是个连驾照都没有、还怕骑车的怂包。

lines.en: : I'm obviously gonna get there first, so...
lines.zh: : 我显然会先到，所以……

lines.en: I hang up the phone after not hearing whatever Yuki was saying at the end there.
lines.zh: Yuki 最后那句话我没听清，就把电话挂了。

lines.en: I'm pretty sure she was going through a tunnel.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她是进了隧道。

lines.en: I'll just take my time and walk over to the second half of town at the same speed I always do.
lines.zh: 那我就慢慢来，照我一贯的速度走到城市另一半。

lines.en: scene black
scene yukigennight
I arrive at the ramen shop to find Yuki already halfway through her meal and quickly order the same thing in an effort to catch up.
lines.zh: 我到拉面店时，Yuki 已经吃了一半，我赶紧点了同样的东西想追上进度。

lines.en: We spend the night discussing the past, present, and future and how none of those sections have been all that enjoyable for either one of us.
lines.zh: 我们聊了一晚上过去、现在和未来，还有这三段对我们俩来说都不怎么愉快。

lines.en: Sure, my present is a lot better than hers right now given that I'm actually able to spend time with her daughter-
lines.zh: 当然，我的现在比她好得多，因为我至少还能跟她女儿待在一起——

lines.en: But it's not like that time ever yields anything worth noting.
lines.zh: 但那些时间也从来没产出过什么值得一提的东西。

lines.en: We're just cogs in a machine that we can't even figure out the function of, and my cog happens to be a little bit larger.
lines.zh: 我们只是一台连功能都搞不清的机器上的齿轮，而我这个齿轮恰好大一点。

lines.en: scene black
But that's okay.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: Because one day, the machine will stop functioning entirely.
lines.zh: 因为总有一天，这台机器会彻底停摆。

lines.en: The parts of my section will be disassembled for the sake of renovating another machine-
lines.zh: 我这个部分的零件会被拆下来，用来翻修另一台机器——

lines.en: While the parts of hers will be discarded or turned into scrap metal.
lines.zh: 而她那些零件会被丢掉，或者熔成废铁。

lines.en: Yuki and I finish our meals and head our respective ways without making any serious progress as far as our relationship goes.
lines.zh: Yuki 和我吃完各自的东西，各走各的路，关系上没有任何实质进展。

lines.en: But at least we seem to have enjoyed the time we spent together.
lines.zh: 但至少我们好像都挺享受一起度过的时间。
